method: Complete seed-averaged source-arm profiles, source-centered outcomes and features, no intercept; LOSO excludes all rows of held-out source from coefficient fitting. Arm dummies omit last arm, then are centered. Skill = 1 - pooled LOSO SSE / pooled zero-deviation SSE.
scope: Held-out outcome mean defines centered scoring labels; relative profile assessment conditional on complete outcomes, not prospective absolute prediction. Realized impulse is output-dependent. Exploratory, associational, fixed intervention menus; no causal attribution or uncertainty interval.
original_results: Original analysis preserved; impulse + allocation is a different model from arm + impulse. Development-to-independent transfer remains the original analysis and changes the arm menu.
